verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor (APU) whose ecosystem consists of inference runtimes, SDKs and an agent framework. User-defined, event-triggered automation rules are not a capability axis for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a rules engine. This is a category error, so the verdict is na rather than none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
